Release.Note: iDM3 now updates itself. The Overview page shows when a new version is available and what changed in every version since yours, and installs it with one click in a few seconds. Projects and settings are kept.
Updates can also be installed automatically whenever iDM3 is closed. The option is on the Overview page and is off by default.
iDM3 opens on a new Overview page: news from ELKO EP, the installed version and update status, release notes for iDM3 and for device firmware, and a link to the user manual.
Device firmware published by ELKO EP can be downloaded from the Overview page, and every file is checked before it is used.
Added the IBWL3-02B and IBWL3-20B relays.
Added support for DALI-2 input devices.
CU error codes are shown with a readable description.
New installations no longer show hidden objects, save function block templates in the project, and start new projects from the default project.
The "Auto restore project at the CU" setting was removed: miniCU does not support it.
The hotel system (HRS / Reception) is no longer part of iDM3.
New installations go to a folder named iDM3, without a version number; an existing installation is updated in place.
The update catalogue and its signature are read from one file, so they always match, even in the minutes right after a release is published.
New firmware is offered from the release that brings it, together with the definitions it needs; older installations are offered the update of iDM3 instead.
The Overview shows the Firmware row only when published firmware is missing, with a Download button; every file is checked against the signed catalogue.
The update check says when no signed catalogue is published, instead of reporting that iDM3 is offline.
A build that is newer than the published release keeps its own firmware files instead of offering older published copies.
A readable description is shown for every CU error code.
Hidden objects are no longer shown by default; function block templates are saved to the project and new projects start from the default project.
The "Auto restore project at the CU" setting is hidden: miniCU does not support it.
